name: Von Karman Vortex Street
recipe: A von Karman vortex street: flow past an obstacle sheds alternating counter-rotating vortices that peel off and drift downstream in the classic staggered double row, swirling dye showing the wake. Continuous shedding on K.t. Default COLORFUL: dye tinted by vorticity (cw cool / ccw warm) streaming across a dark fluid, luminance ~0.2-0.45, edge-to-edge.
kernel: advect a coarse dye field (<=180 wide) through an analytic wake velocity field: uniform flow + a staggered train of Lamb-Oseen vortices spawned alternately top/bottom at a fixed obstacle x, drifting downstream on K.t; inject dye upstream. Map dye+vorticity to colour, upscale. Continuous shedding = motion.
style: dye-wake (default, vorticity warm/cool on dark). Also: schlieren (grey density gradient), thermal, ink-water (indigo on pale), neon-flux (glow).

name: Lissajous Grid
recipe: A grid/table of Lissajous figures: each cell traces a harmonograph curve at an integer frequency ratio (row = x-freq, col = y-freq), the whole matrix of curves slowly precessing as a phase term sweeps on K.t so every cell morphs open<->closed continuously — a hypnotic oscilloscope wall. Default COLORFUL: each cell's curve hue by its ratio (spectral grid) glowing on dark, luminance ~0.18-0.45, edge-to-edge.
kernel: for a P.density-sized grid of cells, draw each cell's Lissajous curve x=sin(m*t+phase), y=sin(n*t) sampled to a polyline with a two-pass glow, m/n = cell indices; phase sweeps on K.t so cells morph; hue by (m,n). Cache nothing heavy; ~40-120 cells.
style: spectral-scope (default, hue-by-ratio glow). Also: phosphor (green CRT scope), amber-crt, blueprint (white on blue), neon.

name: Kuramoto Sync
recipe: A field of coupled Kuramoto phase-oscillators: each cell has a phase that nudges toward its neighbors', so from random noise spontaneous synchronized waves, spirals and phase-domains emerge and sweep the frame — a shimmering map of collective synchronization. Default COLORFUL: phase mapped to the full hue wheel so sync shows as flowing rainbow bands/spirals, luminance ~0.25-0.55, edge-to-edge.
kernel: coarse phase grid in S (<=180 wide); each frame every cell: phase += omega_i*dt + K*mean(sin(neighborPhase - phase)); natural freqs omega seeded per cell; render phase->hue LUT into pixels[] buffer, upscale. Coupling K drifts on K.section (desync<->sync). K.t gates step.
style: phase-wheel (default, full-hue sync bands). Also: ocean (blue/teal), ember (warm), duotone (named mono-ish), bioluminescent.

name: Recursive Tree
recipe: A recursive L-system / fractal tree grows and sways: branches fork with seeded angle+length ratios into a full canopy, wind sways the whole tree on K.t (larger sway toward the tips), leaves/blossoms flicker at branch ends, and it periodically regrows a new species. Default COLORFUL: warm bark trunk fading to luminous hue-shifted foliage tips (or blossom pinks), on a soft gradient sky/dark; luminance ~0.2-0.5, fills frame.
kernel: cache the recursive branch list (depth 8-11, seeded angle/ratio) in S; each frame draw branches with a K.t wind sway applied cumulatively down the depth (tips move most), thickness by depth, hue trunk->tip; blossom/leaf dots at tips flicker on K.t. Regrow (new seed) on K.section.
style: blossom (default, bark->pink/gold canopy). Also: autumn (amber/red), bioluminescent (glowing tree on black), winter-bare (frost branches), ink (named mono, sumi tree on cream).

name: Ferrofluid Spikes
recipe: A ferrofluid under a magnetic field: the black liquid bristles into the iconic array of self-organizing spikes (Rosensweig instability), spikes rising, merging and re-spacing as the field strength pulses. Rendered as a metaball-like fluid surface with sharp peaks + specular highlights. Default COLORFUL: oil-black fluid with iridescent thin-film rim highlights (petrol blue/violet/gold) catching light, on dark; luminance ~0.15-0.4, fills frame.
kernel: a hex/jittered array of spike charge-centers in S whose heights pulse and jitter on K.t (field strength on K.section); build a coarse height/metaball field summing spike bumps, threshold the surface + shade by gradient (specular rim, iridescent tint), upscale. Spikes migrate/merge continuously.
style: petrol (default, oil-black + iridescent rim). Also: chrome (liquid-metal specular), lava (glowing orange fluid), mercury (silver), ink (named mono, black spikes on grey).

name: Snowflake Growth
recipe: Reiter's hexagonal snowflake CA: vapor diffuses on a hex lattice and freezes onto a growing central crystal, spontaneously producing a unique six-fold dendritic snowflake — every seed different. Grow one flake to full size, hold it glittering, then dissolve and grow a new one. Default COLORFUL: ice crystal in cool blue-white with faint iridescent facets on a deep indigo ground, luminance ~0.2-0.5, centered but large (fills ~70%).
kernel: hex-lattice float field (receptive/frozen) in S (<=150 wide) running Reiter's rule (alpha,beta,gamma params); each frame several growth steps; render frozen mass with facet shading via a hex->pixel LUT, upscale. Regrow with a new seed on K.section. Growth is the motion.
style: ice (default, blue-white crystal on indigo). Also: gold-frost (metallic), spectral (iridescent facets), neon (glowing edges), ink (named mono, white flake on black).

name: String Art Envelopes
recipe: Curve-stitching string art: straight threads connecting points along lines/curves weave into glowing envelope curves — parabolas, cardioids, mystic roses across a circle of nails. Multiple layered thread families in different hues, the connection offset animating on K.t so the envelopes breathe and rotate. Default COLORFUL: multi-hue translucent threads (additive) forming luminous moire envelopes on dark, luminance ~0.15-0.4, fills frame.
kernel: define nail sets (circle rings / line pairs) in S; each frame draw N straight threads i->(i*k+offset)%M as thin ADD lines, k+offset drift on K.t so the envelope morphs; layer 2-4 thread families with different hues/centers. Two-pass glow. Nail count / k from params.
style: neon-thread (default, multi-hue ADD envelopes). Also: gold-silk (metallic on black), blueprint (cyan on navy), rainbow-rose (mystic rose), mono (named, white thread on black).

name: Maurer Rose
recipe: A Maurer rose: connecting points on a rose curve r=sin(n*theta) sampled at a fixed degree-step d with straight lines produces intricate star-lattice / celtic-knot-like patterns that transform dramatically as n and d sweep on K.t. Overlay the smooth rose beneath the sharp Maurer polyline. Default COLORFUL: bright hue-gradient Maurer lines over a faint filled rose, glowing on dark; luminance ~0.18-0.45, fills frame.
kernel: each frame: sample 360 points at angle k*d degrees on r=sin(n*theta), connect consecutively with thin glowing lines (the Maurer rose) + draw the smooth rose faintly under it; n (petal count) and d (step) drift slowly on K.t so the lattice perpetually transforms. Hue-gradient along the path, two-pass glow.
style: spectral-lattice (default, hue-gradient lines on dark). Also: gold-leaf, neon, blueprint (white on blue), ink (named mono, on cream).

name: Kelvin-Helmholtz Billows
recipe: The Kelvin-Helmholtz shear instability: two fluid layers sliding past each other roll the interface into the iconic train of breaking billows / cat's-eye vortices (like wind-shear clouds or breaking ocean waves). The billows grow, curl and advect continuously on K.t. Default COLORFUL: two dyed layers (e.g. warm over cool) rolling into interleaved billows, luminance ~0.2-0.5, edge-to-edge.
kernel: advect a coarse two-tone dye field (<=180 wide) through a shear velocity field (opposing horizontal flow across a mid interface) perturbed by a growing sinusoidal instability that rolls up into vortices seeded along the interface; evolve on K.t. Map dye to the two-layer palette, upscale.
style: sky-shear (default, warm/cool cloud billows). Also: ocean-wave (teal/foam), thermal, ink-shear (indigo/cream), aurora.

name: Coulomb Charges
recipe: FIX of a weak version that clumped into a SMALL dark central blob (dead space, lum 0.096). Re-author so 150-260 positive+negative charges SPREAD ACROSS THE WHOLE FRAME and self-organize into visible ionic lattices, dipole chains and alternating +/- checkerboard clumps — filling the frame, NOT a tiny central ball. Use a much WEAKER central confinement (or none — wrap at edges instead) so charges occupy the full frame; stronger short-range Coulomb so alternating lattice STRUCTURE forms; brighter glowing dots (luminance ~0.18-0.35). Optionally draw faint bonds between opposite nearby charges. Default COLORFUL: + warm (red/gold), - cool (cyan/blue) glowing on dark.
kernel: particle array in S (pos,vel,charge; 150-260) on a toroidal domain (wrap at edges — NO tight central well) with softened pairwise Coulomb (O(N^2) ok) + mild damping; integrate; draw ADD glowing dots by charge + optional near-neighbor opposite-charge bonds + short trails into a fade buffer. Perturb on K.section. Fill the frame.
style: ionic (default, warm+/cool- glow, full frame). Also: plasma (violet/cyan), firefly (warm points), lattice-lines (draw bonds), mono (named, white points).
